cards.ex: The game was canceled due to rain.
cards.exUz: O'yin yomg'ir sababli bekor qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning sababi natijasida yuzaga kelgan.

cards.ex: He studied hard, and as a result, he passed the exam.
cards.exUz: U qattiq o'qidi va natijada imtihondan o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror harakat yoki voqeaning oxirgi oqibati.

cards.ex: Smoking can lead to serious health problems.
cards.exUz: Chekish jiddiy sog'liq muammolariga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning boshqa narsaga sabab bo'lishi.

cards.ex: I was tired; for this reason, I went to bed early.
cards.exUz: Men charchadim; shu sababli, erta uxladim.
cards.uzDef: Bu aniq sabab tufayli sodir bo'ldi.

cards.ex: I need to study in order to pass the test.
cards.exUz: Men testdan o'tish uchun o'qishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror maqsadga erishish uchun qilinadigan harakat.

cards.ex: The new policy will bring about positive changes.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosat ijobiy o'zgarishlarga olib keladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning sodir bo'lishiga sabab bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: His anger stems from frustration at work.
cards.exUz: Uning jahli ishdan kelib chiqqan umidsizlikdan kelib chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning manbai yoki kelib chiqishi.

cards.ex: The conference was organized with the aim of promoting cooperation.
cards.exUz: Konferentsiya hamkorlikni rivojlantirish maqsadida tashkil etildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani amalga oshirish maqsadida qilingan harakat.

cards.ex: The outdoor concert was canceled on account of the bad weather.
cards.exUz: Ochiq havoda bo'ladigan konsert yomon ob-havo tufayli bekor qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Biror sababga ko'ra, shu tufayli sodir bo'lgan.

cards.ex: I couldn't come, the reason being I was ill.
cards.exUz: Men kelolmadim, sababi men kasal edim.
cards.uzDef: Buning sababi shundaki...

cards.ex: I saved money so that I could buy a car.
cards.exUz: Men mashina sotib olishim uchun pul yig'dim.
cards.uzDef: Biror maqsadga erishish uchun shu usulda.

cards.ex: The flight was delayed owing to technical problems.
cards.exUz: Parvoz texnik muammolar sababli kechiktirildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning sababi natijasida kelib chiqqan.

cards.ex: He didn't study, and as a consequence, he failed the test.
cards.exUz: U o'qimadi va natija o'laroq, imtihondan o'ta olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror harakatning yoki voqeaning oqibati sifatida.

cards.ex: The funds were raised for the purpose of building a new school.
cards.exUz: Mablag'lar yangi maktab qurish maqsadida yig'ildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga erishish maqsadida qilingan harakat.

cards.ex: With this in mind, we need to plan carefully.
cards.exUz: Shuni nazarda tutib, biz ehtiyotkorlik bilan rejalashtirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Buni esda tutib, shunga asoslanib qilingan ish.

cards.ex: His actions resulted in serious consequences.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari jiddiy oqibatlarga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning oqibatida boshqa narsa sodir bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The alarm was set off by the smoke.
cards.exUz: Signal tutun bilan qo'zg'atildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshlash yoki sabab bo'lish.

cards.ex: The upshot is we have to start again.
cards.exUz: Xulosa shuki, biz boshidan boshlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yakuniy natija yoki xulosa shunday.

cards.ex: It was a good decision in that it saved us money.
cards.exUz: Bu yaxshi qaror edi, chunki u bizga pulni tejashga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror sababni izohlashda ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: She didn't say anything for fear of offending him.
cards.exUz: U uni xafa qilishdan qo'rqib, hech narsa demadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror yomon narsa sodir bo'lishidan qo'rqib.

cards.ex: The effect of the medicine was immediate.
cards.exUz: Dori-darmonning ta'siri darhol sezildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning boshqa narsaga bo'lgan ta'siri.

cards.ex: We need to improve our marketing. To that end, we're hiring a consultant.
cards.exUz: Biz marketingni yaxshilashimiz kerak. Shu maqsadda biz konsultant yollayapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Shu maqsadga erishish uchun qilingan harakat.

cards.ex: His hard work contributed to the team's success.
cards.exUz: Uning mehnatsevarligi jamoaning muvaffaqiyatiga hissa qo'shdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga sabab bo'lish yoki yordam berish.

cards.ex: The rise in fuel prices has had a knock-on effect on food prices.
cards.exUz: Yoqilg'i narxlarining oshishi oziq-ovqat narxlariga domino effektini berdi.
cards.uzDef: Bitta voqeaning ko'plab boshqa voqealarga sabab bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The app is designed to help you learn English.
cards.exUz: Ilova sizga ingliz tilini o'rganishga yordam berish uchun mo'ljallangan.
cards.uzDef: Biror maqsadga erishish uchun yaratilgan.

cards.ex: He was released on the grounds that there was insufficient evidence.
cards.exUz: U dalillar yetarli emasligi asosida ozod qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga asoslanib yoki sababga ko'ra.

cards.ex: In consequence of the accident, he was unable to work.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisa natijasida u ishlay olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror voqeaning natijasida kelib chiqqan.

cards.ex: I went to the interview in hopes of getting the job.
cards.exUz: Men ishga kirish umidida suhbatga bordim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga erishish umidida qilingan harakat.

cards.ex: The first domino started a chain reaction.
cards.exUz: Birinchi domino zanjirli reaksiyani boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Bitta voqeaning boshqa bir qator voqealarga sabab bo'lishi.

cards.ex: I exercise as much as I can.
cards.exUz: Men imkon qadar mashq qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror maqsadga yetishish qadar.
